harness_repair: Fresh-substep current and previous heads are set exactly through XMI before prepare_time_step, avoiding formatted IC restart-state rounding.
bounded_conclusions: Without internal memory, redistributing the same linear input within the window does not change the final shared head.
With an explicit internal storage memory, the same total input produces different final groundwater heads when the forcing order changes, while total water remains conserved.
Shared groundwater head is therefore insufficient to characterize path-dependent column response when internal memory states are present.
The surrogate memory timescale is illustrative and is not a calibrated SWAP parameter.
